episodes.title: Daybreak
episodes.summary: Kevin Costner stars as John Dutton, patriarch of a Montana ranching family, and owner of the largest ranch in the U.S. It's the story of Dutton's fight to defend his land and his family from the modern-day forces that threaten his way of life.

episodes.title: Kill the Messenger
episodes.summary: As the dust settles from the shootout, the Duttons deal with the potential repercussions. John calls in a favor and collects on some old debts. Jamie meets with the governor to do damage control.

episodes.title: No Good Horses
episodes.summary: The Duttons deal with a painful family anniversary. Kayce saves a young girl from danger. Jamie and Beth plan their respective political careers. Rainwater makes an ominous threat to the Dutton legacy.

episodes.title: The Long Black Train
episodes.summary: A secret about John comes to the surface. Beth shows Jenkins a rough night out. Quality time with Tate leads to a close call.

episodes.title: Coming Home
episodes.summary: John tries to convince Kayce and Monica to stay close to home, Jamie works some legal magic, Rip looks for a new cowboy for the ranch, and Beth pursues revenge.

episodes.title: The Remembering
episodes.summary: John reveals a family secret to Monica, Jamie ramps up his political career, Beth pushes John too far, Kayce and Rip butt heads, and a new partnership threatens Yellowstone.

episodes.title: A Monster Is Among Us
episodes.summary: Rip stumbles upon a dangerous and dire situation; a plan is set in motion designed to squeeze John Dutton and threaten his way of life; and Monica begins a tough recovery.

episodes.title: The Unravelling: Pt. 1
episodes.summary: Rip faces a sheriff's investigation after his accident with the tourists, Jamie's political future comes into question, and Beth goes after Dan's finances.

episodes.title: The Unravelling: Pt. 2
episodes.summary: John discovers his true alliances, Rip searches for answers, Jamie's political career is threatened, Beth takes on a new role, and Kayce returns home.

episodes.title: A Thundering
episodes.summary: Kayce settles into his new role at the ranch. A damaging article threatens to expose John. Rainwater pitches his new plan to the tribal council.

episodes.title: New Beginnings
episodes.summary: John makes changes at the ranch, Kayce and Rip face off, Beth makes real estate investments, and Monica starts her new job at the university.

episodes.title: The Reek of Desperation
episodes.summary: Rainwater teams up with Jenkins for a big business deal, but powerful new enemies look to block their plans. John and Beth groom a new political candidate.

episodes.title: Only Devils Left
episodes.summary: John's enemies strike a direct hit on the Yellowstone. John forms an unlikely alliance. Kayce has his first day as a livestock officer.

episodes.title: Touching Your Enemy
episodes.summary: Jamie tries desperately to walk back a previous mistake; Kayce tracks down evidence; Monica and Martin attend a traditional Indian horse relay.

episodes.title: Blood the Boy
episodes.summary: John prepares to partner with a former pair of foes. Jamie makes a drastic move to protect the ranch. Jimmy takes a shot at a bull riding competition.

episodes.title: Resurrection Day
episodes.summary: Tensions escalate as the Beck brothers become frustrated by the Duttons' unwillingness to play ball. Jamie looks for a fresh start. Tate gets his first horse.

episodes.title: Behind Us Only Grey
episodes.summary: John and Rip seek revenge; Monica ponders the consequences of her living situation; Jimmy clears old debts.

episodes.title: Enemies by Monday
episodes.summary: Rip helps Jimmy retaliate after a tragedy, Beth comes to Monica's aid, Jamie learns surprising news, and the Duttons' fight with the Becks takes a dire turn.

episodes.title: Sins of the Father
episodes.summary: The feud between the Becks and the Duttons comes to a violent conclusion, Kayce searches for his son, and Rip receives a surprise inheritance.

episodes.title: You're the Indian Now
episodes.summary: In the wake of the Beck Brothers, John reshuffles the political decks; Beth finds a trespasser on the ranch and learns that he may have big ambitions for the surrounding land; John helps Tate deal with his nightmares.

episodes.title: Freight Trains and Monsters
episodes.summary: Jamie starts a new job. Beth comes to a realization about Market Equities and visits Roarke. Rip searches for another ranch hand. A livestock agent goes too far.

episodes.title: An Acceptable Surrender
episodes.summary: Jamie hatches an elaborate plan, Beth learns details about Ellis Steele's proposal, Governor Perry requests a meeting with John and Jamie, and Jimmy competes at the rodeo.

episodes.title: Going Back to Cali
episodes.summary: Beth shares a personal secret with Rip. John and the boys deal with some hostile trespassers from out of state. Rainwater reaches out to a powerful woman to help secure the future of Broken Rock.

episodes.title: Cowboys and Dreamers
episodes.summary: The reason for Beth and Jamie's toxic relationship is revealed. Kayce bends the rules to help a family in need. Rip and the boys get into a confrontation with two men from John's past.

episodes.title: All for Nothing
episodes.summary: Kayce and Monica help search for a missing Indigenous woman, Market Equities presents Jamie with a lucrative offer, and John finds out about Beth and Jamie's secret.

episodes.title: The Beating
episodes.summary: Jamie has a major revelation. Beth makes plans for her future. Jimmy meets a rodeo legend. Rip's patience is tested.

episodes.title: I Killed a Man Today
episodes.summary: Beth continues her battle with Willa Hayes, and brings John a lucrative offer. Monica has a harrowing ordeal.

episodes.title: Meaner Than Evil
episodes.summary: Jamie confronts his past. Rip approaches Kayce about an old problem. The bunkhouse looks to defend two of their own.

episodes.title: The World Is Purple
episodes.summary: John sits down at the negotiating table with former friends and foes, and as the battle for the future of the Yellowstone heats up, nothing will ever be the same.

episodes.title: Half the Money
episodes.summary: The coordinated attack on the Duttons continues, as everyone searches for answers on who is responsible. Rip delivers on a promise.

episodes.title: Phantom Pain
episodes.summary: The Yellowstone recovers and begins planning revenge. Rainwater receives an offer from a newcomer. Rip gets a surprise.

episodes.title: All I See Is You
episodes.summary: John seeks revenge with help from some unexpected allies. Kayce solves a problem with an unconventional method. Beth gives Carter his options. Jimmy prepares for a change.

episodes.title: Winning or Learning
episodes.summary: Jamie receives some surprising news. Beth receives an offer. Jimmy settles in on the road. Tensions boil over in the bunkhouse.

episodes.title: Under a Blanket of Red
episodes.summary: John and Kayce are forced to deal with some newcomers in town. Lloyd is in the doghouse with Rip, and finds purpose in teaching Carter. Jamie seeks information about his father.

episodes.title: I Want to Be Him
episodes.summary: Beth confronts her father's houseguest. Kayce and his family search for a new home. Jamie seeks answers from Garrett. Lloyd loses his cool.

episodes.title: Keep the Wolves Close
episodes.summary: John is put in an awkward position by Governor Perry. Carter works to earn back Beth's trust. Jamie is in for a big surprise.

episodes.title: No Kindness for the Coward
episodes.summary: Tensions escalate with the protestors, but Beth has a plan. Jimmy and Emily get closer. Monica and Kayce share a special moment.

episodes.title: No Such Thing as Fair
episodes.summary: John and Beth squabble. Cowboy School is over for Jimmy, who has an important decision to make. Kayce begins a new quest. Jamie realizes Garrett's past might affect his own future.

episodes.title: Grass on the Streets and Weeds on the Rooftops
episodes.summary: To the Duttons, family is everything. But newfound truths threaten that bond. Jimmy comes home, and has important decisions to make. Beth takes family matters into her own hands.

episodes.title: One Hundred Years Is Nothing
episodes.summary: John is sworn in as governor of Montana, settles into the powers of his office and makes bold moves to protect the Yellowstone, and the bunkhouse and the Duttons enjoy the Governor's Ball.

episodes.title: The Sting of Wisdom
episodes.summary: John makes a passionate speech to the state of Montana, a formidable new opponent from Market Equities arrives on a private jet, and the cowboys on the Yellowstone deal with a new problem.

episodes.title: Tall Drink of Water
episodes.summary: Beth heads to Salt Lake City to take care of unfinished business. A trap is set for Jamie. Kayce makes an important decision for his family.

episodes.title: Horses in Heaven
episodes.summary: John makes swift changes at the Capitol. Later, he receives some advice from Senator Perry. The venom between Jamie and Beth reaches a boiling point.

episodes.title: Watch 'Em Ride Away
episodes.summary: John tells Clara to cancel his Capitol meetings to brand cattle with the Yellowstone cowboys. Beth's disdain for a perceived rival reaches a boiling point.

episodes.title: Cigarettes, Whiskey, a Meadow and You
episodes.summary: The Duttons and the Yellowstone enjoy an almost perfect day branding cattle. Montana gets an unexpected visitor from outside. Sarah continues to sink her teeth into Jamie. Rainwater deals with a challenger from within.

episodes.title: The Dream Is Not Me
episodes.summary: John deals with a problem with his herd. Sen. Perry delivers news to Rainwater. Jamie and Sarah plan their next move. The entire Yellowstone enjoys a rare evening of fun together. Beth discusses a new business plan concerning the ranch.

episodes.title: A Knife and No Coin
episodes.summary: Jamie goes through with his plan; John has a request for Monica and lends support to an unexpected friend; the Yellowstone cowboys embark on a big change; a flashback reveals a source of Rip's loyalty.

episodes.title: Desire Is All You Need
episodes.summary: After an event rattles the state of Montana, nothing will ever be the same.

episodes.title: The Apocalypse of Change
episodes.summary: Beth comes to a chilling realization. Kayce reaches out to an old friend in search of information. Jamie meets with Market Equities.

episodes.title: Three Fifty-Three
episodes.summary: Beth discusses the fate of the ranch with an unlikely ally. Kayce takes the investigation into his own hands. Jamie looks to advance his political agenda.

episodes.title: Counting Coup
episodes.summary: Kayce makes a bold move. Rip asks for help from a friend in Texas, while the bunkhouse contemplates their future. Jamie attempts to cover his tracks.

episodes.title: Give the World Away
episodes.summary: Jamie begins to spiral, and later seeks advice. Beth and Travis make a deal. Kayce has an idea about the future of the ranch.

episodes.title: Life Is a Promise
episodes.summary: As the Duttons and the Yellowstone cowboys lay John to rest, the fate of the ranch is revealed.
